EZE: A chief of the Igbo people.
EZEK: Abbreviation of Ezekiel (book of the Bible).
EZEKIAS: King Hezekiah, in the New Testament form.
EZEKIEL: A book of the Old Testament of the Bible.
EZINE: A magazine published in electronic form, especially on the World Wide Web.
EZO: A former name for the Ainu.
EZR: Abbreviation of Ezra (book of the Bible).
EZRA: The fifteenth book of the Old Testament and a book of the Hebrew Tanakh.
